_scope: VALIDATION targets — exercise the field error variants the Figma masters define (07_错误·格式 / 07_错误·强度 / 错误·未填写 / 两次密码不一致). Per the design these render INLINE on the field (red border + ⚠ helper text), so expect.feedback='inline'. The probe types a bad value / a mismatching confirm, blurs + submits, then checks WHERE the feedback landed (inline vs dialog vs silent). Server-side states (07_错误·未注册 / 08_错误·不对 / 08_错误·已过期) are wired in code via mapServerError; they require backend round-trip and aren't driven here.

_note: 07_错误·强度 — typed password fails backend PASSWORD_REGEX. With the regex tightened to mirror prod, an obviously-weak value triggers inline feedback (red border + ⚠ helper).

Cross-field: password mismatch. precondition fills the password field first, then this confirm field gets a different value. The error belongs to the confirm field per register's pattern. Sample updated to a 12+ value so the password field itself passes the strength check, isolating the mismatch state.
